placements.why: No strata exist yet for this repo. The content is a reproduction of a documented production failure paired with pass/fail guarantees — a proof-point discipline (regression-against-real-failure, with explicit non-crash/valid-output criteria) distinct from Opportunity, Strategy, Product, Architecture, or Organization framing. Minting Proof gives future test-case and validation content a home.
placements.title: Evidence Discipline: Correctness Demonstrated Against Real Failure, Not Assumed
placements.frame: Does this artifact demonstrate the system correctly handling a known real-world failure mode, rather than merely asserting correctness?

placements.title: Id Derivation Must Degrade Safely on Malformed Input, Not Just Succeed on Clean Input
placements.frame: Does this test case reproduce a real missing-id/malformed-heading failure and confirm the derivation path fails safely (no crash) while still producing a valid, usable slug?
placements.why: src-1 states the test reproduces a specific known production failure pattern (## heading with no id field) and src-2 states the required safe-degradation outcome (no crash, valid slug). Together they name a recurring theme future test envelopes will keep feeding — id-derivation robustness under malformed/missing input — not a one-time fact. No existing leaf covers this (structure supplied is empty), so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Proof strata.
